subject.title: [AI] fix(memory): backfill provider.model with resolved model name in…

question: Should OpenClaw accept this source-layer `provider.model` normalization for memory indexes before the broader auto-provider migration work lands?
rationale: The patch is narrow and appears correct, but it changes persisted memory identity and vector lookup semantics for adapters that previously returned an empty model.

options.title: Land after upgrade-aware review
options.body: Accept the backfill if maintainers are satisfied that normalizing empty returned provider models to the resolved adapter model is the intended upgrade behavior.

options.title: Request full persisted-index proof
options.body: Ask for a live existing-index reindex plus `memory_search` query transcript before merge if source and focused tests are not enough for this storage path.

options.title: Pause for broader provider policy
options.body: Hold this PR only if maintainers want this source backfill bundled with the auto-provider migration decision tracked elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Land after upgrade-aware review
recommendation.body: Accept the backfill if maintainers are satisfied that normalizing empty returned provider models to the resolved adapter model is the intended upgrade behavior.
